script.es: Tacos de verdad, hechos al momento.

parrafo.es: Tacos, sopes, burritos y quesadillas de asada, al pastor, carnitas y mas, preparados al momento en nuestro food truck de Homestead. Mesas al aire libre bajo la sombra, de martes a domingo.
parrafo.en: Tacos, sopes, burritos and quesadillas with asada, al pastor, carnitas and more, made to order at our food truck in Homestead. Outdoor picnic tables in the shade, Tuesday through Sunday.

hero.imagen_alt: Canasta de tacos recien preparados en Taqueria Cinco Hermanos, Homestead FL

parrafo_1.es: Taqueria Cinco Hermanos es un food truck familiar en Homestead que prepara tacos, sopes, burritos y quesadillas al momento, con las recetas de siempre: asada, al pastor, carnitas, buche, pollo, lengua y cachete.
parrafo_1.en: Taqueria Cinco Hermanos is a family food truck in Homestead making tacos, sopes, burritos and quesadillas to order, with the same recipes as always: asada, al pastor, carnitas, buche, pollo, lengua and cachete.

parrafo_2.es: Trabajamos bajo una carpa con mesas al aire libre entre palmeras: la idea es que se sienta como comer en casa, no como una fila de comida rapida. Abierto de martes a domingo, cerrado los lunes.
parrafo_2.en: We work under a tent with outdoor picnic tables among palm trees: the idea is that it feels like eating at home, not standing in a fast food line. Open Tuesday through Sunday, closed Mondays.

texto.es: Encuentranos en 27200 SW 177th Ave, Homestead, o llama al (786) 339-0698 para preguntar por el menu del dia.
texto.en: Find us at 27200 SW 177th Ave, Homestead, or call (786) 339-0698 to ask about today's menu.

texto.es: Tacos, sopes, gorditas, tostadas, burritos, quesadillas o enchiladas: escoge tu carne, de asada a cachete.
texto.en: Tacos, sopes, gorditas, tostadas, burritos, quesadillas or enchiladas: choose your meat, from asada to cachete.

texto.es: Cada orden se prepara fresca al momento, con cilantro, cebolla, rabano y limon como siempre.
texto.en: Every order is made fresh on the spot, with cilantro, onion, radish and lime as always.

texto.es: Sientate en las mesas al aire libre entre palmeras, o pide para llevar. Abierto de martes a domingo.
texto.en: Sit at the outdoor picnic tables among palm trees, or order to go. Open Tuesday through Sunday.

texto.es: Asada, al pastor, carnitas, buche o pollo en tortilla de maiz, con cilantro, cebolla, rabano y limon. Cachete $4, lengua $5.
texto.en: Asada, al pastor, carnitas, buche or pollo on a corn tortilla, with cilantro, onion, radish and lime. Cachete $4, lengua $5.

texto.es: La misma variedad de carnes sobre masa gruesa de maiz. Version cachete o lengua $5.
texto.en: The same variety of meats on thick corn masa. Cachete or lengua version $5.

texto.es: De asada o cualquier carne a tu gusto, con frijoles, queso, lechuga y tomate. Version cachete o lengua $14.
texto.en: Asada or any meat of your choice, with beans, cheese, lettuce and tomato. Cachete or lengua version $14.

texto.es: Quesadilla de harina desde $10, a la plancha desde $4. Enchiladas rojas $14, version cachete o lengua $15.
texto.en: Flour quesadilla from $10, griddled from $4. Enchiladas rojas $14, cachete or lengua version $15.

pie.es: Tambien: chips con pico $5, arroz o frijoles $1.50, combo de arroz y frijoles $3. Los sabados hay sopa de mariscos, y los domingos, menudo y caldo de res.
pie.en: Also: chips with pico $5, rice or beans $1.50, rice and beans combo $3. Saturdays bring seafood soup, and Sundays menudo and beef caldo.

items.quote: Hands down the most delicious tacos I've ever eaten. We have lived in the area for 4 years and the taco truck has been a regular the entire time. I've never been disappointed. The Al pastor tacos are seasoned to perfection.

Absolutely delicious food! The tacos were a standout, the corn shells looked handmade and the carnitas were so flavorful. Outdoor shaded seating with a cool breeze made the entire vibe very enjoyable.
This taco truck never fails, always fresh, always clean, and just a great outdoor set up. Hands down the best taco truck in homestead.

texto.es: Estamos en Homestead, cerca de Krome Ave, bajo una carpa con mesas al aire libre.
texto.en: We're in Homestead, near Krome Ave, under a tent with outdoor picnic tables.

texto.es: Martes a jueves 9:00am-9:00pm. Viernes y sabado 9:00am-10:30pm. Domingo 9:00am-10:00pm. Lunes cerrado.
texto.en: Tuesday to Thursday 9:00am-9:00pm. Friday and Saturday 9:00am-10:30pm. Sunday 9:00am-10:00pm. Closed Mondays.
